videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny competes against Mrs. Drysdale as artists and tells Jed about her uncle, the barn painter. Jed and Jethro go to an upscale gallery to buy a painting, but are mistaken for gardeners. Bessie the chimp dabbles with a paintbrush.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: After Ellie seems to be no longer interested in Dash Riprock Granny decides it's time to do a little matchmaking. She thinks the handsome actor would be perfect for Miss Jane.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Mr. Drysdale talks the Clampetts into hiring a housekeeper. Unfortunately, the housekeeper that is hired is uninterested in doing housework.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Jethro decides to turn his favorite thing, eating, into a job by getting the family involved in buying a diner. The family's choice of offerings lead to a lack of customers, so Mr. Drysdale tries to fix things.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Jethro, worried that his diner the Hungry Gizzard has no customers, has a wonderful idea. He busts in on Mr. Drysdale trying to impress the wealthy Vanderpools, announcing the restaurant is going topless. Confusion ensues.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny wants to leave sunny California because she misses winter, sending Mr. Drysdale into a panic. The banker enlists Miss Jane in an elaborate scheme to convince the Clampetts that a blizzard has occurred.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The last televised wrestling match was such a success that the promoter wants a rematch. Granny isn't interested until Rebecca's parents visit.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny is worried about Miss Jane's spinsterhood and convinces Jethro to ask her to marry him. Granny assures him that she will decline the proposal, but Hathaway accepts, leading to panic in the Clampett household.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny is on the warpath concerning the chaos caused by Ellie's critters and declares either they go or she does. Mr. Drysdale is equally irritated by the expense of his wife's poodle. Jed tries to find a solution.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny and Jethro believe they have psychic abilities, but Granny's predictions stop coming true. With her reputation on the line, she picks a stock for Mr. Drysdale that could cost him a small fortune.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Heading to England, Jethro smuggles Ellie's turkey buzzard on the plane upsetting Mr. Drysdale and a fellow passenger. After landing, they try to meet with the Queen to give her their 80 million dollars. Their butler Faversham tries to clear things up.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: After the Clampetts return from London, Granny gets a letter from Hooterville asking her to help with Betty Jo Elliot's baby.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: While Granny is away in Hooterville, Mr. Drysdale hires a gorgeous Italian cook who speaks no English.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny and the Italian chef compete to see who will cook for the family.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The Clampetts spend Thanksgiving in Hooterville.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Mr. Drysdale casts Dash Riprock as Homer Noodleman, a potential new lover for Elly May.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Jethro wants a new identity with the replacement of their old truck with a modern hot rod. Granny wants to stay with the old truck. To prove how good the old truck is, Granny races Jethro in his hot rod.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The Clampetts prepare to go to Hooterville for Christmas.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Mr. Drysdale follows the Clampetts and Miss Jane to Hooterville where they are spending Christmas. He takes Ellie's bear Fairchild with him and gets himself thrown in jail in a little town. Sam Drucker shows up to help.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Mr. Drysdale is sick, and Dr. Granny springs into action with a chimp as a nurse. But Ellie's bear Fairchild has taken a liking to granny's flu remedy. During this, Mrs. Drysdale tries to impress society Mrs. Van Ransonhoff.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Jethro is evicted because his 50 cent allowance won't cover the rent. The other Clampetts take over the space with Granny will cut hair or pull teeth. Jed will sharpen tools and whittle something. Ellie is the pretty receptionist.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: With the Clampetts established in business in Jethro's vacated office space, a building inspector visits to find out about their business operations on the 5th floor.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Mr. Drysdale hires a troubleshooter for the bank. His main mission is to get the Clampetts to close their business operating out of the 5th floor.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Sam Drucker comes to Beverly Hills to visit, and Granny assumes he's interested in courting her.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Jethro meets Mrs. Drysdale's guru and decides he wants to be one also. Granny thinks it's all nonsense, but when she tries to put a stop to it the followers find her common sense inspiring and make her the head guru.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The Drysdales now jog so the banker can get the account of Jason Detweiler, head of a running club. The Clampetts don't understand the concept, leading to misunderstandings, then Ellie and Jethro become enthusiastic.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Famous singer Pat Boone is in the neighborhood and smells Granny's cooking. He wanders into their backyard and the Clampetts befriend him, thinking he's a hill country man down on his luck.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The hillbillies move back to the hills to find Elly May a husband, much to the dismay of banker Drysdale.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The Clampetts arrive in the mountain town of Silver Dollar City, where Granny starts a feud with an old rival, Elverna Bradshaw.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Granny continues her efforts to get Elly May married, extolling the young girl's virtues to every bachelor she meets.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Bird watcher Jane Hathaway hikes into the woods and finds a man for Elly May.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: The Clampetts rehearse for Elly May's wedding to backwoodsman Matthew Templeton, unaware that banker Drysdale wants it stopped.

videos.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
videos.overview: Drysdale and Jane arrive in New York to persuade the hillbillies to abandon their half-built cabin in Central Park and return home.
